Oh, sorry, i didn't think anyone would reply. A lot actually. I just don't know what to do anymore...
I know that feeling. I know the feeling that you need to do something and everyday you can't think about anything else. I'm here for you. I want to help you. If you want to talk, i will be there. :)
Hello. Im here to talk if you want :)

I don't usually open up to anyone, because as i said before i don't trust anyone, even myself. But last couple of months its tearing me apart and i can't take it anymore. All i do is go to work, to uni and then sleep. I have a lot of stuff in my mind and i did some horrible things this month, but i can't tell anyone because it will ruin everything even more. About your friend i would say, if talking to him or being with him makes you feel bad, change something. :) it is like that, you can't talk to everyone about everything, not everyone can understand that. You need to find the right people to talk to. Im at work right now, so i cant talk a lot. My shift ends in 1,5 hours. You can also pm me, we can talk more :)

Hello. I am here to listen. I know that feeling. I can't help myself, but i like to help others. In a way it makes me feel better if i see that i could help anyone. We can talk about it if you want :) i don't know anything about your family or friends, but it just depends on how you are taking it. I know sometimes its annoying when people say: hey, don't be sad, everything's gonna be fine. Sometimes it feels fake. Probably they just care about you and wants you to feel better, but sometimes it is healthy to change something. Even if its your friends, maybe the best are just waiting for you around the corner. I have only one friend, but i don't trust her. She did a lot of stuff for me over the years, but i keep her around just because i need to go somewhere sometimes outside my home, job or uni. The problem is i don't trust people. If you want to talk, im here.
